spec: Implement the user-supplied requirements at https://github.com/contoso/travel-concierge/issues/28. Source revision: 2026-09-21T13:05:00Z. Task acceptance criteria below map that scope to specialist-owned work.

tasks.title: Make the evaluations runnable in CI
tasks.body:
Turn `evals/` into a uv project with a runner that targets a given Responses endpoint, scores every dataset, writes results with the agent version and exits non-zero below a threshold. Document the command in `AGENTS.md`.

## Acceptance criteria
- The runner fails when any metric is below `evals/thresholds.json`.
- Each result file records the agent version and the dataset it ran against.
- The cloud agent's setup steps can run the evaluations.

tasks.title: Deploy from GitHub Actions with OIDC
tasks.body:
Add `.github/workflows/deploy.yml` that signs in with a federated credential and runs `azd deploy` on pushes to `main`, using a protected GitHub environment.

## Acceptance criteria
- No Azure secret or client secret is stored in the repository or its settings.
- The deploy identity has the Foundry Project Manager role on the project only.

tasks.title: Gate the deploy on the evaluations
tasks.body:
Add an evaluation job to `deploy.yml` that builds the image, starts the agent host in the job, runs the evaluation runner against it and uploads the results; the deploy job needs it.

## Acceptance criteria
- The deploy job cannot run when the evaluation job fails.
- Evaluation results are uploaded as a workflow artifact for every run.
